senses.gloss: (denom. of טיבור) [to measure the length from shoulder to belly, v.
units: Macc. III, 13, a. Bart. a. l.; Tosef. ib. V (IV), 15,] to lash a transgressor with a strap commensurate to his size (v. מַלְקוּת). Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ (expl. מצליף, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:5">ib. V, 5</cite>) <he>כמְטַבְרֵיר</he> Ar. s. v. <he>צלף</he> (ed. <he>כמטוורד</he>, read <he>כמְטַוְורֵר</he>, cmp. <cite ref="I00215"><he>טַוְורָא</he></cite>) like the movement of the lasher in court; (cmp. Bab. ib. 55ᵃ top <he>כמנגדנא</he>).
